description:
Sentiment and opinion analysis for customer reviews, messages and social media posts written in spoken Arabic dialects (Moroccan Darija, Egyptian, Gulf, Levantine and others), in Arabic script, Arabizi or mixed with French/English. Returns overall sentiment, a score from -1 to 1, the aspects mentioned (price, delivery, quality, service...) with their sentiment, the detected dialect and a one-line English summary. Built for review monitoring, social listening and customer support triage.

Pricing: $0.02 per successful call. Free daily trial without an API key; unlimited with a plan key, or pay per call autonomously through the Apify Actor ali-lamtoueq/darija-mcp (x402/MPP/Skyfire).

dialect.description: Dialect of the text, if known. Default: auto-detect.
